name: Welcome to {{APP}}
description: A short tour of what {{APP}} has beyond the usual

rootFirst.title: Welcome
rootFirst.synopsis: What this project is, and the stops of the tour.

draft.title: The Icon Bar
draft.synopsis: Ten document icons, one click each; icons from text and from your own pictures.

draft.title: Zoom Where You Point
draft.synopsis: Ctrl+mouse wheel over any part of the window; every part keeps its own zoom.

draft.title: Mind Maps
draft.synopsis: A board of notes, lines, and arrows for every document. This one has a board: open the Mind Map tab.

notes.text: What a mind map can do
Notes: double-click an empty place. Ctrl+Enter makes a new note below the selected one.
Lines: drag a note onto another one. Drag it there again to remove the line.
Arrows: hold Alt while you let go. Ctrl+Alt: an arrow back. Ctrl+Alt+Shift: both ends.
Colors, shapes, and borders: right-click a note.
Icons at the corners and sides of a note, and in the middle of a line.
Background shapes group notes. A magnetic shape takes its notes along.
Menu > Notes > Add Notes to the Binder turns notes into documents.
Export as PDF, PNG, text, OPML, or a Scapple file; Scapple files can be read.

draft.title: Object Sheets
draft.synopsis: People, places, and things of a story, each on a sheet of fields, linked to each other.

children.title: A Scene in Ashvale
children.synopsis: A short scene with links to the objects. The Objects tab lists who and what appears in it.

draft.title: Comments of a Whole Folder
draft.synopsis: The comments and footnotes of every document in a folder, in one list.

draft.title: A Chapter with Comments
draft.synopsis: Select it and open the Comments & Footnotes tab of the inspector.

children.title: Evening
children.synopsis: A scene with a footnote and an inline annotation.

draft.title: Compare and Transfer
draft.synopsis: A manuscript back from Word or LibreOffice: see what differs and take over either side.

draft.title: Scrivener Projects
draft.synopsis: Import a Scrivener project, or work in it directly and go on in Scrivener later.

draft.title: Themes, Colors, and Fonts
draft.synopsis: Dark mode and other themes at once; the color palette of the format bar; installing fonts.

draft.title: Updates and Add-ons
draft.synopsis: Small package files, the Add-on Manager, and a way back to an earlier version.

draft.title: Safety Nets
draft.synopsis: Autosave, backups, snapshots, the spare project file, crash and freeze reports.

draft.title: Where Next
draft.synopsis: The Quick Start Guide, the manual, and a project of your own.

values.traits: Patient, stubborn, keeps every promise she makes.
values.background: She took over the ferry from her mother. [Tobias Quill](qbobj-name:Tobias Quill) found her mother's name in the old ferry book.

values.goals: Wants to know who wrote the first pages of the ferry book.

values.description: Forty houses along a slow river, a ferry, and a church tower that can be seen from [Fenwood](qbobj-name:Fenwood).

values.flora: Birches and alders; reeds along the river.

values.effects: The ferry stops when the far bank cannot be seen.
